module_summary: 12-hour BCD clock: cascaded BCD digit counters for seconds, minutes, hours plus AM/PM toggle, advanced on ena via a carry-enable vector from terminal-count compares.

anchors.name: ss
anchors.why: Two-digit BCD seconds counter 00-59, base of the cascade

anchors.name: mm
anchors.why: Two-digit BCD minutes counter 00-59 incremented on seconds rollover

anchors.name: hh
anchors.why: Two-digit BCD hours counter 01-12 wrapping 12 to 01

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Per-digit carry enables decoded from terminal counts of lower digits

anchors.name: ena
anchors.why: Once-per-second tick gating all counter updates

groups.name: time_counters
groups.description: Cascaded BCD seconds, minutes, hours counters and AM/PM flag

groups.name: carry_decode
groups.description: Terminal-count compares producing carry enables for each digit
